title: 第三章 永关城第四章 黑虎武馆
slug: 双穿美利坚人狱苟到玄幻发育
content_zh:
..........
因此，要想习武，永关县是必须去的一站。
只是阿贵的记忆里并无县城的详细印象，他从未去过。
因为没牛车，去一趟城里根本不现实，平常有人来村里有收猎物。
眼看天色渐晚，林枫决定先找个地方落脚。
略一思索，还是先回阿贵的村子，借宿一晚，顺便打听情况。
张家村有近百户人家，八成姓张。
林枫的目标是村长张三石村里只有他家有牛车，也只有他去过永关县城。
村长张三石有个儿子，名叫张武，在城里镖局做镖师，常年在外奔波。
张武与阿贵是发小，一起长大，两家颇为熟络。
两个月前，消化了阿贵的记忆后，林枫便着手准备。
他身上这套粗布衣裳，就是照着记忆里的样式，在现代另行置办的。
他背上一个行囊，将必要物品收好，头发依旧是利落的短发，并未佩戴假发。
这方世界并无“身体发肤受之父母”的束缚，剃光头的大有人在，发型随心，无人指摘。
临近傍晚，夕阳沉入西山，林枫才抵达张家村。
凭着阿贵的记忆，他对村子颇为熟悉。
村里孩童看见他这个生面孔，都好奇地跟在身后张望。
林枫没有理会，径直走向村长家。
约莫十分钟后，他来到一处土坯院墙外。
院墙用黄泥垒砌，木门干裂变形，门缝宽得能塞进手指。林枫抬手叩响了门上的铁环。

咚咚咚……
“谁呀？”
“张叔，我是张武的朋友，路过此地，特来探望您。”
门内传来一阵急促的脚步声。透过门缝，隐约见一个人影快步走来。
“嘎吱——”
木门打开，现出一位清瘦的老者。
他背微佝偻，面容黝黑，爬满皱纹，身高大约五尺（约1.6米）。
此人正是张三石。
与此同时，张三石也在打量林枫.
身高八尺，相貌俊朗，面色红润白皙，气质不像寻常村汉，倒似大户人家的公子，只是头发短了些。
然而对方口音，却带着本村土韵，着实奇怪。
转念一想，许是跟儿子张武学的。
想到此处，张三石眼中多了几分亲切。
content_en:
...........
Therefore, if you want to practice martial arts, Yongguan County is a must-visit stop.
It's just that Agui has no detailed impression of the county seat in his memory. He has never been there.
Because there is no bullock cart, it is impossible to go to the city. People usually come to the village to collect prey.
Seeing that it was getting late, Lin Feng decided to find a place to stay first.
After thinking about it for a moment, I decided to go back to Agui's village first, stay overnight, and inquire about the situation.
There are nearly a hundred households in Zhangjia Village, and 80% of them have the surname Zhang.
Lin Feng's target is village chief Zhang Sanshi. He is the only one in the village who owns a bullock cart, and he is the only one who has been to Yongguan County.
Village chief Zhang Sanshi has a son named Zhang Wu who works as an escort in the city's bodyguard bureau and travels around all year round.
Zhang Wu and Agui grew up together, and the two families are quite familiar with each other.
Two months ago, after digesting Agui's memory, Lin Feng started making preparations.
The coarse cloth clothes he wore were purchased in modern times according to the style in his memory.
He carried a bag on his back and put away the necessary items. His hair was still neatly short and he did not wear a wig.
This world is not bound by the "body, hair, and skin of parents". There are many people who shave their heads and style their hair as they please without anyone criticizing them.
Towards evening, when the sun sank into the western mountains, Lin Feng arrived at Zhangjiacun.
Based on Agui's memory, he was quite familiar with the village.
When the children in the village saw his unfamiliar face, they followed him curiously and looked around.
Lin Feng ignored it and walked straight to the village chief's house.
About ten minutes later, he arrived outside an adobe courtyard wall.
The courtyard wall is built with yellow mud, the wooden door is cracked and deformed, and the door gap is wide enough to fit a finger in. Lin Feng raised his hand and knocked on the iron ring on the door.
Dong dong dong...
"Who is it?"
"Uncle Zhang, I am Zhang Wu's friend. I am passing by and came to visit you."
There was a rush of footsteps inside the door. Through the crack in the door, I vaguely saw a figure walking quickly.
"Crunch——"
The wooden door opened, revealing a thin old man.
He is slightly stooped, has a dark, wrinkled face, and is about five feet (about 1.6 meters) tall.
This person is Zhang Sanshi.
At the same time, Zhang Sanshi was also sizing up Lin Feng.
He is eight feet tall, handsome in appearance, with a rosy and fair complexion. His temperament is not like that of an ordinary village boy, but rather that of a young man from a wealthy family, except that his hair is shorter.
However, the other person's accent had a local rhyme to it, which was really strange.
On second thought, Xu learned it from his son Zhang Wu.
Thinking of this, Zhang Sanshi's eyes became a little more cordial.
